paragraphs: Rav Idi, Rabbi Yaakov’s father, was called “the one-day student of the academy.” He spent three months traveling to Rabbi Yochanan’s academy, studied one day, traveled back three months, and stayed home one day. The students laughed at him. Rabbi Yochanan expounded, “They seek Me day by day”: one who studies Torah one day is as though he studied the entire year. Chagigah 5b. See Bar Yomi, under bet and yod. Ein Yaakov reads Rav Idi, son of Rabbi Yaakov bar Idi.
